revisions.title: From gods to daimons to the body as sign
revisions.body: The etymological survey moves in order from gods to daimons, heroes, human beings, and then soul and body. For soma, Socrates presents several possibilities: the body may be the soul's tomb, a sign through which the soul signifies, or an Orphic enclosure; he says the last account seems most persuasive, without settling the alternatives as doctrine.
